variants.headline: Building finished and handed over
variants.body: The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Delivery reached; opening follows
variants.body: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A completed project leaves the builder's hands
variants.body: Completion and handover of {project} have been achieved by {builder}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
